verdicts.reason: A keeps the original three-column structure across the leaderboard, with a readable centred headline flanked by the two copy blocks. Its flaws are minor: the right block re-wraps into four lines that leave 'WORLD!' orphaned and jammed against the panel's right edge, and the panel almost fills the height, so the top and bottom margins are thin. B shrinks the panel to a narrow centre column with large empty areas of wood on both sides. Its headline is pushed up against the top edge, and the two secondary copy blocks are stacked under it at a tiny size that is unreadable at the target size. That destroys the banner's left-to-right reading order and leaves the layout cramped.
